title: fix(lint)!: refuse a list-view chart bound to a dataset over another object
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBBvzHnt6XJAsoWun9t3Y1WU)_

Fixes #26719

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: updated here — `content/docs/data-modeling/analytics.mdx` gains the rule and its remedy; no `skills/**` file teaches list-view chart bindings, so no skill changes.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：列表视图的图表如果绑定的数据集建在别的对象上（比如项目列表下画任务数据），发布时直接拒绝（422），`os validate` / `os build` 也报错；草稿保存不拦，与其他作者期规则一致。
- 为什么改：这种图表画的是别的对象的数据，却挂在本对象列表下，用户会把任务统计当成项目统计看，而以前保存和发布都返回 200、没有任何提示。
- 风险与回滚：只新增一条 lint 规则，不改任何 schema；仓内 examples 与 platform-objects 没有视图被它拒绝。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/lint/src/validate-list-view-field-refs.ts`（`checkChartDataset` 与新增文档段）、`packages/lint/src/validate-list-view-field-refs.test.ts` 末尾的 `[#26719]` 段、`.changeset/26719-list-view-chart-foreign-dataset.md`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-list-view-field-refs.test.ts -t 26719`，应见 16 条全绿（拒绝、同对象对照、关系可达也拒绝、四种视图形态、运行时保存门）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（窄化需先过契约档复核）。

## What changes

A list view's `chart` binds an ADR-0021 dataset, and the chart draws the rows of that dataset's base `object`: the list hands `queryDataset` the dataset name, dimensions and measures and nothing else, so neither the list's object nor its filter reaches the query. A chart under one object's list bound to a dataset over another object plotted the other object's records under the first object's name, and saved and published `200`.

- **New rule** `list-view-chart-dataset-foreign-object` (`error`) in `validateListViewFieldRefs`, the list-view lint family that already judges columns and the #24563 closure binding. One finding per list view, at `chart.dataset`; `where` names the view, the message names the dataset and both objects, the fix line names the remedy.
- **Why this family and not `validateChartBindings`.** The claim and the issue name `packages/spec`, but the list-view lint family lives in `packages/lint` (the spec holds no business logic). `validateListViewFieldRefs` already resolves the list view's bound object on every shape the save door carries (a view item record, a flattened list overlay, a container's `list` / `listViews`, an object's built-in `listViews`, with a list view's own `data.object` winning) and already runs at the `view` and `object` doors. `validateChartBindings` runs at the `flow` and `report` doors only, and does not walk the view-item or flattened shapes, so landing the check there would not have reached the door the QA measured.
- **A dataset that reaches the view's object through a declared relation is refused, not accepted.** `include` lists to-one relationships FROM the dataset's base object, so a dataset over `crm_opportunity` that includes `account` still counts and sums opportunities: the relation adds columns to group by, never a second row set. Nothing maps the list's object onto the dataset either (that mapping was refused as option B of ruling 5825582592). Equality of the two object names is the one test that says the chart plots the rows the list lists. Pinned both ways (an `owner`-including task dataset is refused under the person list and admitted under the task list).
- **Not judged here, each with an owner:** a dataset that resolves to nothing (`chart-dataset-unknown`), a dataset with no `object`, a list view whose binding does not resolve (`list-view-object-outside-closure` / `list-view-object-unknown` / skip 1). The dataset's own package is not judged: when its object is the view's own, that object is already inside the written package's closure.
- `os explain list-view-chart-dataset-foreign-object` carries the reasoning; `LIST_VIEW_CHART_DATASET_FOREIGN_OBJECT` is exported from `@objectstack/lint`; `content/docs/data-modeling/analytics.mdx` states the rule.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/lint` minor, BREAKING accept-set narrowing, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`; the body states the remedy and carries no FROM → TO rewrite, since that disposition refuses a prescription.

## Why

Studio QA S5 (studio-qa-2026-10-27): authors got a chart of unrelated data under an object's list without any warning.

## Tests

- New `[#26719]` block at the end of `packages/lint/src/validate-list-view-field-refs.test.ts`, 16 cases: the refusal (rule, `error`, path `views[0].list.chart.dataset`, `where` names the view, message names the dataset and both objects, one-line fix ≤ 200 chars); the same-object control (silent); the relation case both ways; the four other list-view shapes (`objects[].listViews`, `views[].listViews`, a flattened overlay, a ViewItem record) each at its own path; a list view's own `data.object` winning over its container's; silence where another verdict owns the case (unknown dataset, dataset with no `object`, unresolved binding); an object with no readable field map still judged; `validate` and `build` both fail; at the runtime save door (`runRuntimeAuthoringRules`, type `view`, under a package closure) a view item bound to another package's object's dataset is refused and the same view on its own object's dataset is admitted; `os explain` carries the relationship answer.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test` on the merged tree (merge commit `3ccc765c`; the later commits touch only the changeset and one docs page): Test Files 168/168, Tests 7446/7446. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck` exit 0 (same lock, `VERDICT command-exit 0`).
- Ablation (source, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor hit 1 → 0, blob `eeb9791a` → `d078fc8e`): removing the `checkChartDataset(...)` call turns 11 of the block's cases red; the 5 controls stay green, as expected. Restored: anchor back to 1, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- **Landing site.** The claim's file surface says `packages/spec`; the list-view lint family it names (cf. #24563) lives in `packages/lint`, and the change is there. `packages/spec` is untouched.
- **Draft saves are not gated**, as for every author-time rule: the QA's `?mode=draft` PUT still answers 200, and its promotion (`POST /api/v1/meta/view/NAME/publish`) now answers 422.
- **Security reading (asked by the card): the dataset read enforces the caller's permissions on the foreign object. Not a finding.** Measured live on this branch's base (`c8583f80`, showcase boot, a non-builder `member`): a dataset over `chartgap_item` (member has no read) → member `POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query` `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` ("reading chartgap_item is not permitted"), the same with an inline dataset body; a dataset over `showcase_contact` (member `GET /data` 403) → dataset query 403; a dataset over `showcase_inquiry` (member reads 0 of 3 rows by `GET /data`) → dataset `row_count` 0 for the member, 3 for admin. Object-level admission and the row scope both hold at the dataset door.
- **Out of scope, reported to the seat (class a, not fixed here):** `validateChartBindings` runs at the `flow` and `report` doors only and does not walk the view-item or flattened list shapes, so at `PUT /api/v1/meta/view` a chart list view whose dataset resolves to nothing, or whose `values` names no measure of its dataset, publishes `200` (measured on `c8583f80`: `no_such_dataset` and `ghost_measure`, both as a view item and as a container's `listViews`). Crossing that member onto `view` is its own refusal widening with its own corpus measurement.
- **Corpus.** `examples/**`, `apps/**`, `packages/platform-objects`, `packages/plugins` and `packages/services` declare two chart list views (showcase `task.view.ts` → `showcase_task_metrics` over `showcase_task`, `project.view.ts` → `showcase_project_metrics` over `showcase_project`); both are their own object's. Nothing to fix. `packages/rest/src/meta-view-chart-binding.test.ts` binds `lead_metrics`, which its harness does not register, so the rule is silent there.

## Verification

- Live, on this branch (lint rebuilt, showcase `pnpm dev -- --fresh`, package `com.qa.chartgap` with object `chartgap_item`): a chart list view bound to `showcase_task_metrics` (over `showcase_task`) → publish `422 INVALID_METADATA` with `list-view-chart-dataset-foreign-object` at `views[0].config.chart.dataset` (view item) and `views[0].listViews.lv_foreign2_publish.chart.dataset` (container); draft `200`; the draft's promotion `422`. Bound to `chartgap_item_metrics` (over `chartgap_item`) → `200` on every path, promotion `200`.
- Before, on `c8583f80`: the same four writes bound to `showcase_task_metrics` all answered `200`.
- Derived gates at `9634b5a3`: `dispatch-gates --commands` → 87 families, 87 run, all exit 0 (`check-adr-0087-registration` first exit 1 on a FROM/TO label in the changeset, fixed in `9634b5a3`, re-run exit 0); `dispatch-gates --ran` → 87 derived, 87 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- Full dogfood (owed for a narrowing): at `9634b5a3`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the verify lock (`VERDICT command-exit 0`, 16m43s): Test Files 314 passed, 3 skipped (317); Tests 2609 passed, 20 skipped (2629); no failure.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No spec change.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` is CI's run.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the maintainer brief is Chinese by rule).
